title: Contact
subtitle: Open to Senior Frontend roles in the Netherlands — and conversations about architecture, design systems, and performance.

form.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. Your message has been recorded locally — connect a form backend (e.g. Formspree) to deliver it to zafth98@gmail.com.

faq.question: What kind of roles are you looking for?
faq.answer: A Senior Frontend role focused on React, TypeScript, Next.js, frontend architecture, design systems, and performance — with room to grow into Staff-level ownership. Open to healthcare, fintech, travel, SaaS, and other product domains.

faq.question: Are you open to the Netherlands?
faq.answer: Yes — Amsterdam, Rotterdam, and Utrecht are priorities. I am Kennismigrant sponsorship eligible and open to remote, hybrid, or on-site arrangements.

faq.question: Can I download your résumé?
faq.answer: Yes — use the résumé link on the homepage or contact page to download the latest PDF. The portfolio content is kept in sync with that document.
